description: Sarphatiparkbuurt side streets 1881-1887 (Govert Flinckstraat, Eerste Van der Helststraat, Eerste Jan Steenstraat): 4.8-6.6 m fronts of a raised ground storey and three upper storeys of red-brown brick; three axes of white T-windows under segmental brick heads; white sills; a white frieze and cornice at about 14 m; one white pediment dormer with a hoist beam over the middle axis

match.note: Govert Flinckstraat 265-287 (1886), Eerste Van der Helststraat 51-67 (1881), Eerste Jan Steenstraat 1-43 (1886): cornice 13.0-14.9 m on the 2016-2023 strips; 3DBAG 4-5 bouwlagen; the strip skyline reads the dormer at 15.5-16.5 m (frontSkylineM)

pediment-dormer.note: Govert Flinckstraat 265-287: one white dormer about 1.6 m wide over the middle axis, 14.9-17 m, pediment and hoist beam

door-left.note: a residential door at the left party wall beside the shop

rhythm.groundFloor: a raised house door and windows, or a shop
rhythm.roofline: white frieze and cornice at 14 m, one pediment dormer
schemaLimits: the cornice consoles of Govert Flinckstraat 265-287 are drawn as a plain frieze
